type: Flatseam / coverseam machine (绷缝机) controller with stepper motor presser foot lift and top cutting function
source: K7电控使用说明书V1.7-中文.pdf (V1.7, 2025-4-11, Chinese only, 25 pages, 研发用/for R&D)
note: K7 is a flatseam (coverseam/绷缝机) machine controller — different from lockstitch (平缝/A4C) and overlock (包缝/C5/C7-A). Key features: (1) Stepper motor presser foot lift (E-21 to E-29 stepper errors); (2) Top cutting function (上剪线, button 10) — specific to flatseam machines; (3) HG edge folding function (P13/P14); (4) IoT connectivity (P25/P26/P28, 3-part serial number); (5) Voice broadcast (P98/P99); (6) Thread sweeping/blowing (P39/P40/P43); (7) 13-button panel with 7-digit digital tube display (segment LCD, not graphic LCD). Parameter numbering uses mixed decimal and hexadecimal notation (e.g., 13E, 18A, 205, 232 are hexadecimal R&D params). Factory type codes: 3008=step cut+lift+35AC, 3002=UTL+CS+35AC+top cut, 3304=UTL+HG+35AC, 3006=UTL+HG+CS. System param 25 can be used to look up the internal speed limit password.

parameterEntry.userParams: Long press P in standby → enter user param number interface. Short press left/right to move cursor. When cursor on param number: long/short press + or - to change param number. When cursor on param value: long/short press + or - to change value. Short press P to save (shows OK, returns to param number). 20s no action or short press P → exit to standby. Pedal press down → immediately exit.
parameterEntry.rdParams: Long press P + power on → enter R&D param number interface. Same navigation as user params. 20s timeout.
parameterEntry.systemParams: Long press P + right key in standby → enter password interface. Use voice/trim/LED/stop-position keys to input digits. Default password: 1111. Short press P to confirm. Enter system param interface. Same navigation. 20s timeout.
parameterEntry.monitoring: Long press P + mid-stop presser foot key simultaneously in standby → enter monitoring number interface. Short press left/right to move cursor. Long/short + or - to change monitoring number. Short press P to exit to idle. From monitor interface: long press right key to save user custom params; short press left key to switch P99 voice type.
parameterEntry.speedQuickAdjust: In standby: short/long press + key to increase max speed P1 (auto-save, shows RPM). Short/long press - key to decrease. 20s no action or short press P → auto exit. Note: P1 max is controlled by R&D param 241.
parameterEntry.voiceToggle: Long press voice key (13) in standby → toggle voice on/off.
parameterEntry.trimmerToggle: Short press trimmer key (12) in standby → toggle trim on/off.
parameterEntry.counterDisplay: Long press P + up key (+) in standby → enter stitch/piece count display. Left/right to switch between stitch count and piece count screens. Up/down to directly modify count. Short press mid-stop presser foot key or LED key to exit.
parameterEntry.countClear: In count/piece interface: long press P + down key (-) to clear corresponding count.
parameterEntry.userCustomSave: Set param 163 to 2, then long press P → system defines current modified params as user custom params. Success shows OK. To restore: long press Reset key (3s+) → restore user custom params.
parameterEntry.factoryRestore: After long press P (R&D mode), hold left + right keys for 1s → all params restore to factory. INIT displayed, then OK.
parameterEntry.sleepMode: P33 (default 30 min, non-zero) when motor is not running and panel idle time accumulates to P14 setting, panel enters sleep mode (displays SLEEP). Press any key to exit.
parameterEntry.motorMagneticPoleInitAngle: Step 1: Power on long press P, return to idle, long press P + voice key. Step 2: Panel shows LA, step pedal to 7th digit running light. Step 3: Success shows initial angle 2s. Step 4: Shows OK = success.
parameterEntry.internalSpeedLock: Step 1: Power on long press P, adjust param 255 to 1, short press P → password interface. Set password via left/right/+/- and save. Step 2: Switch to param 241, modify max speed, short press P. Step 3: Enter password. Step 4: To clear password set P255=0 (requires original password). Step 5: If password forgotten, check system param 25.
parameterEntry.iotSerialNumber: Standby → long press P → enter user params → set P26=1 → short press P → enter 3-section serial number setting. OR: standby → long press P + LED key → shows XLH → long press P + LED key → serial number setting. Use left/right to select digit, +/- to set value. Short press P to save all 3 sections. Long press P to exit.

errorCodes.description: 硬件过流 (Hardware overcurrent)
errorCodes.solution: Turn off system power, restart after 30 seconds. If controller still cannot work normally, replace controller and notify factory.

errorCodes.description: 软件过流 (Software overcurrent)
errorCodes.solution: Turn off system power, restart after 30 seconds. If still fails, replace controller and notify factory.

errorCodes.description: 系统欠压 (System undervoltage)
errorCodes.solution: Disconnect controller power and check if input voltage is below 176V. If low, restart after voltage returns to normal. If still fails, replace controller.

errorCodes.description: 系统欠压 (System overvoltage during shutdown)
errorCodes.solution: Disconnect power and check if input voltage is above 264V. Restart after voltage normalizes. If still fails, replace controller.

errorCodes.description: 运行时过压 (Overvoltage during operation)
errorCodes.solution: Disconnect power and check if input voltage is above 264V. Restart after voltage normalizes. If still fails, replace controller.

errorCodes.description: 电流检测回路故障 (Current detection loop failure)
errorCodes.solution: Turn off, restart after 30s. Try several times. If fault occurs frequently, replace controller and notify factory.

errorCodes.description: 电机堵转 (Motor stall)
errorCodes.solution: Disconnect controller power. Check motor power input plug for looseness/damage. Check for foreign objects around machine head. Restart after fixing. If still fails, replace controller.

errorCodes.description: 制动回路故障 (Brake circuit failure)
errorCodes.solution: Turn off. Check white braking resistor connector on power board for looseness/detachment. Re-plug and restart. Replace if still fails.

errorCodes.description: 面板通讯故障 (Panel communication failure)
errorCodes.solution: Check control panel and controller connection for looseness/breakage. Reconnect and restart. Replace controller if still fails.

errorCodes.description: 机头停针信号故障 (Machine head needle stop signal failure)
errorCodes.solution: Check motor optical signal for looseness and motor initial angle correctness. Fix and restart. If still fails, replace controller.

errorCodes.description: 电机初始角度检测故障 (Motor initial angle detection failure)
errorCodes.solution: Turn off power and try 2-3 times. If still reports fault, replace controller and notify factory.

errorCodes.description: 电机超速保护 (Motor overspeed protection)
errorCodes.solution: Turn off, restart after 30s. Try several times. If frequent, replace controller.

errorCodes.description: 控速器故障 (Speed controller/pedal failure)
errorCodes.solution: Check pedal speed controller connection for looseness/damage. Restart. If still fails, contact local service.

errorCodes.description: 抬压脚电机硬件过流 (Presser foot motor hardware overcurrent)
errorCodes.solution: Check that supply voltage is normal.

errorCodes.description: 抬压脚电机软件过流 (Presser foot motor software overcurrent)
errorCodes.solution: Check supply voltage is normal. Try factory reset or power restart.

errorCodes.description: 抬压脚电机电流回路检测异常 (Presser foot motor current loop abnormal)
errorCodes.solution: Try turning off power and restarting.

errorCodes.description: 抬压脚电机堵转 (Presser foot motor stall)
errorCodes.solution: Check if machine head is stuck or hard to turn. Check motor plug and motor sensor connector for looseness.

errorCodes.description: 抬压脚编码器Z信号错误 (Presser foot encoder Z signal error)
errorCodes.solution: Check encoder and drive wire are properly connected.

errorCodes.description: 抬压脚编码器AB信号故障 (Presser foot encoder AB signal failure)
errorCodes.solution: Check encoder and drive wire are properly connected.

errorCodes.description: 底线检测报警 (Bobbin thread detection alarm)
errorCodes.solution: Press P to cancel alarm, or alarm auto-stops after time. Then re-thread bobbin properly.

errorCodes.description: 握手错误 (Handshake error)
errorCodes.solution: Check control panel and controller connection for looseness/breakage. Fix and restart.

errorCodes.description: 缺相报警 (Phase loss alarm)
errorCodes.solution: Check IGBT.

errorCodes.description: 过载报警 (Overload alarm)
errorCodes.solution: Try turning off power and restarting.

alarmCodes.solution: Stitch count has reached the set limit. Press P key to cancel alarm and restart count.

alarmCodes.description: 计剪线数报警 (Trim count alarm)
alarmCodes.solution: Trim count has reached the set limit. Press P key to cancel alarm and restart count.

alarmCodes.description: 翻台开关报警 (Table flip switch alarm)
alarmCodes.solution: 摆正机头 (Correct machine head to proper position).

troubleshooting.issue: Stitch count or piece count needs to be cleared/zeroed
troubleshooting.cause: Count has reached limit or needs manual reset
troubleshooting.solution: Enter count display (long press P + up key). Navigate to stitch or piece screen with left/right. Long press P + down key (-) to clear the corresponding count.

troubleshooting.issue: Max speed is restricted below P1 setting
troubleshooting.cause: R&D param 241 (machine head max speed) is set lower than P1
troubleshooting.solution: Access R&D params (long press P + power on). Navigate to param 241. Increase to desired max speed (200-6000 rpm). P1 is then limited by param 241 at highest priority.

troubleshooting.cause: R&D param 255=1 (speed lock enabled) and max speed is password protected
troubleshooting.solution: Enter R&D params. Switch to param 241, modify speed, short press P. Enter password when prompted. If password forgotten: check system param 25 to view stored password.

troubleshooting.cause: IoT module needs serial number configured
troubleshooting.solution: Long press P in standby → modify P26=1 → short press P → enter 3-section serial number. Or: long press P+LED in standby → shows XLH → long press P+LED → serial number interface. Short press P to save after all 3 sections set.

troubleshooting.issue: Upper needle stop angle calibration needed
troubleshooting.cause: Machine stop angle drifted or motor replaced
troubleshooting.solution: Enter monitoring interface (long press P + mid-stop presser foot key). Navigate to monitoring item 024. Rotate handwheel clockwise to upper needle stop position (value changes with handwheel). Long press P + LED key to save upper stop angle.
